messages:
chris: Noticing a subtle uptick in fncall validation rejects after the v2 streaming rollout. Mostly on partner routes. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/validate?panel=fncall_rejects

anya: Can you paste a sample? quick look would help. :eyes:

chris: Pulled a couple. Validator errors are enum_mismatch and unexpected_null. Strange part: some rejects occur even after our adapter claims to run. Example below.

```
# validator error
{\"path\":\"$.output.status\",\"error\":\"enum_mismatch\",\"expected\":[\"SENT\",\"FAILED\"],\"actual\":\"sent_ok\"}
\n# streamed model fragment (as stored)
{\"output\":{\"id\":\"msg_88\",\"status\":\"sent_ok\"}}
```

devon: That looks like legacy labels again. Adapter mapping should convert sent_ok -> SENT. Why is validator seeing it?

chris: Traced the pipeline: streaming deserializer emits partial frames and we validate each frame immediately. The adapter's normalization runs when the full message assembles, so earlier frames get validated pre-adapter.

anya: Oof. Twofold fix: 1) Ensure validator runs post-normalization for assembled objects. 2) Emit telemetry fields so we can triage in console quickly.

devon: Agreed. For quick visibility, add `validation_phase` = "pre_adapter"|"post_adapter", `adapter_applied` = "true"|"false", and `stream_fragment` = "true"|"false" to validation events. That lets console break down rejects by phase and route.

chris: Also propose `auto_fix` boolean if an adapter corrected the value during postprocess; we can show auto-correct rate.

ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: apply route-level override -> SOFT for /partner/* until fix lands. Ops can do that if you want.

anya: Do it. We don't want customer-facing hard rejects during rollout.

ops-bot: rollout override applied: shape-rollout-v2 /partner/* -> SOFT at 2026-04-02T14:12Z by ops.

devon: Console work: i'll add a compact tile showing (pre_adapter_rejects / total_rejects) and (auto_fixed_count / post_adapter_rejects) by route. Need stable field names from telemetry.

chris: I'll open two small PRs: 1) pipeline change to delay validation until post-normalization for assembled objects (streaming fix). 2) telemetry-only PR adding fields: validation_phase, adapter_applied, auto_fix, stream_fragment, route, model_variant. PRs will include schema version bump and changelog.

chris: PR 6012 opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/6012 (streaming validation fix).

chris: PR 6013 opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/6013 (telemetry fields).

anya: Nice. After PRs land, sample failed payloads (redacted) and replay through updated pipeline to measure post-adapter reject rate. If post_adapter rejects return to baseline, we can re-enable strict gating for the rollout.

devon: Security: we'll need redaction rules for sampling. @morgan can you sign off?

ops-bot: replay job queued: replay-1780004321-001 triggered.

chris: One more request: add a subtle alert on console when pre_adapter_rejects > 10% of total for any route during a rollout — that's an early signal streaming-deserializer issues. Low-noise but actionable.

anya: +1. I'll add that to the rollout checklist and runbook. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
